messages:
rahul: promo stuck in CI: deploy-bot failing on cache prefetch (504). change window live, ~15m left.
kevin: saw it, artifact in registry. prefetch retries 5/10 and counting.
deploy-bot: automated: promotion promo-91422 triggered by rahul at 1718004321. state=PREFETCH_RETRY attempts=5 last_error=504.
sam-oncall: looking at cache-service, s3 proxy threads stuck. rolling one proxy node now.
lina: options: wait (risk missing window), abort, or manual promote with pinned digest + --skip-cache-prefetch. prefer manual unless infra says its healthy.
kevin: we have tested skip-prefetch on staging. command: `deploy-bot promote --env prod --image-sha sha256:deadbeef01 --skip-cache-prefetch --tag manual-skip-031` if infra signs off.
sam-oncall: infra signs off for manual promote; i'll continue rolling restarts and open incident.
rahul: go ahead kevin, but require immediate smoke and 2% canary for 30m + rollback entry.
kevin: kicking manual promote now. job promo-91423 queued.
deploy-bot: update: promo-91423 started. prefetch skipped by flag. stage=activation -> in-progress.
deploy-bot: success: promo-91423 completed. prod image=sha256:deadbeef01. tag=manual-skip-031.
rahul: smoke running, canary routing enabled. watching 5xx and latency.
sam-oncall: proxy restarts reduced 504s from ~25% -> ~2% in 3m. opening INC-2026-03-cache-23 for follow-up (suspect connection leak).
lina: release note: "Manual promotion due to cache prefetch 504s. Promoted sha256:deadbeef01; prefetch skipped. Canary 2% for 30m. Rollback target sha256:beefdead99."
kevin: release notes and rollback playbook updated. pinning this thread to release doc and closing promo hold. follow-ups: add circuit-breaker to deploy-bot prefetch and doc skip-prefetch flow.
